reader_summary.headline: My guest today is my friend Wolfgang Hammer.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is my friend Wolfgang Hammer. Wolfgang is a successful film producer and executive who helped create House of Cards and ran several major studios, including Lionsgate, CBS Films and Miramax. He’s now building a new kind of film studio with support from Mitch Lasky and Marc Andreessen.

key_points.text: Wolfgang also helps founders and CEOs use storytelling to better understand what they do, and why it matters.
In many ways, this conversation is a manual for how to find that story and communicate it in a way that resonates.
Wolfgang shares the questions and tools he gives leaders to help them do the same.
